heading: Projects, all of them and how many there are
text: There are seven projects written up here in total, 7 of them: Project Horus, Silmaril AI, Wearable AI chat, CV intelligence platform, Query Sphere, Stay-booking platform, Interactive 3D Portfolio. That is the complete list of the projects on this site.

heading: Project: Project Horus
text: Project Horus is a project I built. An automated pipeline that identifies students from live video, matching faces against an enrolled index in real time. Detects faces in real time with YOLO and SCRFD, then generates ArcFace embeddings for each detection. Matches those embeddings against a FAISS vector index to assign identity. Tuned for reliability across varied edge-case environments and high-throughput processing. Built with YOLO, SCRFD, ArcFace, FAISS.

heading: Project: Silmaril AI
text: Silmaril AI is a project I built. A strategic platform for venture capital that extracts financial metrics from pitch decks and turns them into structured insight. Parses pitch decks with an AI-driven engine that extracts financial metrics automatically. Delivers automated growth recommendations alongside Company Scores and Founder insights. Built with AI-driven parsing engine, Financial metric extraction.

text: Wearable AI chat is a project I built. AI chat software for high-end wearables (Whoop), built for ultra-low-latency, lightweight inference at the edge. Focused on ultra-low-latency responses so the chat experience keeps pace with live wearable data. Runs lightweight edge inference suited to wearable hardware constraints. Built with Edge inference, Low-latency AI chat.
